title: nan
authors: Zahran S.; Mostafa M.M.; Masiero A.; Moussa A.M.; Vettore A.; El-Sheimy N.
key_contribution: Proposes using a micro FMCW radar, UWB devices, and IMU to provide position estimates for UAV navigation in GNSS-denied environments, validated with a quadcopter flight experiment.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
